summary.text: Karen Kirsch is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 7 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Lee Whiting.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as marketing and advertising.

paragraphs.text: Karen Kirsch earned an associate degree from Madison Area Technical College and a bachelor's degree from Mount Mary University.
Her career experience includes working in advertising, marketing and PR.
Kirsch took office in the Assembly in January 2025, succeeding Daniel Riemer.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Regulatory Licensing Reform and State Affairs.
